Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 다음엔 더 잘할거라고 약속했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After failing the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> promises to do even better next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼を失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、次はもっとうまくやると約束した。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>保证下次会做得更好。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>保證下次會做得更好。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué à la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a promis de faire encore mieux la prochaine fois.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hatte die Mission nicht geschafft und versprach, es beim nächsten Mal noch besser zu machen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> promete hacerlo aún mejor la próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Depois de falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> prometeu fazer ainda melhor da próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็สัญญาว่าจะทำให้ดีขึ้นในครั้งหน้าค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> berjanji akan melakukan yang lebih baik lain kali.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hứa sẽ làm tốt hơn vào lần tới.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: क्वेस्ट में असफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अगली बार और भी बेहतर करने का वादा किया।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Yeah, you'll do better next time!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: そうだ、次はもっとうまくやろう！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ouais, fais mieux la prochaine fois!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Ja, beim nächsten Mal machen wir es besser!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: ¡Sí, lo harás mejor la próxima vez!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: É isso aí, da próxima vez você vai se sair melhor!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ใช่แล้ว! ครั้งหน้าต้องทำให้ดีกว่านี้!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Ya, lain kali pasti lebih baik!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đúng vậy, lần tới sẽ làm tốt hơn!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: हाँ, अगली बार तुम और भी बेहतर करोगे!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: I have a Vitality Potion. Want to drink it?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションがあるけど、飲む？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: J'ai une Potion de Vitalité. Tu veux en boire ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Ich habe einen Vitalitätstrank. Möchtest du ihn trinken?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Tengo una poción de vitalidad. ¿Quieres beberla?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Eu tenho uma Poção de Vitalidade. Quer beber?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มีโพชั่นพลังชีวิตอยู่ ดื่มไหมคะ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Aku punya Ramuan Vitalitas. Mau minum?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Có bình thuốc sinh lực đây. Muốn uống không?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: मेरे पास एक वाइटैलिटी पोशन है। क्या तुम इसे पीना चाहोगे?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 초천재 엘리트인 자신만 믿으라고 큰소리로 외쳤다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> got a swelled head and told everyone to trust her super genius elite self.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、超天才エリートである自分だけを信じろと大声で叫んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>大声喊叫，要我只相信她这个超级天才精英。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>大聲喊叫，要我只相信她這個超級天才精英。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a crié à haute voix que seul son génie d'élite devait être cru.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> wurde übermütig und rief laut, man solle nur seinem/ihrem supergenialen Elite-Selbst vertrauen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se envaneció y les dijo a todos que confiaran en su yo de súper genio de élite.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ficou toda convencida e disse a todos para confiarem em sua supergênia de elite.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พองตัวขึ้นและบอกให้ทุกคนเชื่อมั่นในตัวอัจฉริยะขั้นเทพอย่างเธอค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> berteriak lantang agar semua orang hanya percaya pada dirinya yang super jenius dan elit.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã lớn tiếng hô hào rằng mọi người hãy chỉ tin tưởng vào bản thân siêu thiên tài ưu tú của cô ấy.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने जोर से चिल्लाते हुए कहा कि केवल उस पर, जो एक सुपर जीनियस एलीट है, भरोसा किया जाए।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 평소보다 마음의 여유가 없어 보인다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looked more flustered than usual after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、普段より心の余裕がないように見える。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起来比平时更缺乏从容。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起來比平時更缺乏從容。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait plus troublée que d'habitude après avoir échoué à la quête.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sah nach dem Scheitern der Mission aufgeregter aus als sonst.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecía más nerviosa de lo habitual después de fallar la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecia mais nervosa do que o normal depois de falhar na missão.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูจะลนลานกว่าปกติค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terlihat lebih gelisah dari biasanya setelah gagal dalam misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trông bối rối hơn bình thường.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> क्वेस्ट में असफल होने के बाद सामान्य से अधिक परेशान दिख रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> freute sich, nachdem er/sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดีใจที่ได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गई।
